svg.metadata:
Render from the repository root with the Ouroboros icon (rounded like the macOS squircle): magick -font /System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial.ttf \ assets/og-preview.svg /tmp/ouroboros-og-layout.png magick assets/icon_1024.png -resize 232x232 \ \( -size 232x232 xc:none -fill white -draw "roundrectangle 0,0 231,231 52,52" \) \ -compose DstIn -composite /tmp/ouroboros-og-icon.png magick /tmp/ouroboros-og-layout.png /tmp/ouroboros-og-icon.png \ -geometry +84+199 -composite -strip assets/og-preview.png pngquant --force --output assets/og-preview.png --quality 80-95 \ assets/og-preview.png
Verify at 1200x630 and 600x315. This is the Pages/social-card OG asset; assets/social-preview.svg remains the separate GitHub social-preview source.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
